cancellationPolicyPassengerWindow: Passengers may cancel their reservation within 1 hour of booking. After 1 hour, normal cancellation is no longer permitted.
cancellationPolicyDriverLate: If the driver arrives more than 20 minutes later than the agreed time and proof is provided, the passenger may submit a compensation claim for 2% of the ride amount.
cancellationPolicyPassengerLate: If the passenger is more than 10 minutes late, does not show up, or cannot be contacted, the driver may cancel the ride. In this case, 20% of the ride amount is refunded.
cancellationPolicyWaitingFee: At European airports, waiting time may be estimated at EUR 0.15 per minute only after the driver agrees to wait.
cancellationPolicyRefundTiming: Refunds for online payments are processed within 4 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel1: Free cancellation within 1 hour of making the reservation.
cancellationPolicyCancel2: After 1 hour from making the reservation, the customer receives 20% of the ride amount back. The refund is processed within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel3: If the driver arrives more than 20 minutes late and the customer can prove this via chat messages or screenshots of calls, the customer receives compensation of 5% of the ride amount. This compensation is paid out within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel4: In the event of a no-show, the driver may wait a maximum of 10 minutes. After these 10 minutes, the ride is automatically cancelled. The customer then receives 20% of the ride amount back within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyAirport1: For airport rides, a free waiting time of 30 minutes applies after the agreed arrival time.
cancellationPolicyAirport2: If the customer is not present within these 30 minutes, a waiting fee of €0.15 per minute is charged, provided the driver agrees to continue waiting.
cancellationPolicyAirport3: If the driver does not agree to continue waiting after the free 30-minute waiting time, the ride is cancelled and the customer receives 20% of the ride amount back within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancelDialog: You can cancel within 1 hour of booking. Refunds for online payments are processed within 4 business days. After 1 hour, cancellation is blocked unless you submit a driver-delay compensation claim.

privacyPolicyIntro: Fat7i processes personal data in accordance with the AVG/GDPR regulations.
privacyPolicyDataCollectedBody:
• Name
• Phone number
• Email address
• Pickup and drop-off address
• GPS location
• Payment details
• Device information
privacyPolicyPurposesBody:
• Booking and carrying out taxi rides
• Contact between customer and driver
• Customer service
• Payment processing
• Fraud prevention
• Improvement of the service
privacyPolicyRightsBody:
• Access to data
• Correction of data
• Deletion of data
• Withdrawal of consent
privacyPolicyAccountDeletionBody: Users can delete their account through the app or by email. Requests are processed within 30 days.
termsServicesBody: Fat7i offers taxi transport, airport transfers and international rides.
termsReservationsBody: A ride is final after confirmation through the app.

termsCancellationBody:
• Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure.
• Within 24 hours, charges may apply.
• In case of a no-show, the full ride amount may be charged.
termsClientResponsibilityBody: Provide accurate information and do not cause any damage.
termsCompanyResponsibilityBody: Fat7i is not liable for delays due to traffic, weather conditions or force majeure.
termsPrivacyBody: Personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
